scope: Read-only historical source and aggregate-report inspection; new B0-B7 proposal is not executed performance.

operator_comparisons.implemented: Frozen TITAN slide encoding, official vision projection, 32 morphology phrases and two templates; static cosine descriptors.
operator_comparisons.new_B5_difference: Reuses those frozen phrases; adds CONCH-local phrase read and train-side clinical-background residual interaction. No new concept vocabulary.
operator_comparisons.result: 519 slides/512 patients; official probability agreement error 1.49e-08; effective rank 4.4883. Concept versus native TITAN proxy superiority not established.

operator_comparisons.implemented: Top512 RNA to 16D adapter, basis/gate produces text-vector delta after text encoding.
operator_comparisons.new_B5_difference: Does not adapt the text embedding from RNA. Fixed text selects morphology; RNA remains separate molecular evidence.
operator_comparisons.result: No stable superiority over static/additive on T/N/M/Stage; no survival endpoint read.

operator_comparisons.implemented: RNA-conditioned soft prompt inserted after BOS into the frozen TITAN text Transformer; corrected shifted CLS mask and official template averaging.
operator_comparisons.new_B5_difference: No dynamic token prompt or TITAN Transformer updates. Query identity and residual complementarity are separate controlled operators.
operator_comparisons.result: Three fixed epochs; patient-specific mechanism unconfirmed; v1 invalidated, preserved. Wrong RNA is frozen inference intervention, not real retraining.

operator_comparisons.implemented: S32 scalars become learned concept tokens plus identity; clinical tokens and RNA8 queries attend raw CONCH patches, bidirectional attention variants, learned anchor and nonlinear small correction.
operator_comparisons.new_B5_difference: True frozen text prototypes replace score-token-only identity. Background mean estimators are outcome-free crossfit nuisance regressors, not clinical query injection.
operator_comparisons.result: INCONCLUSIVE within repeatedly developed TCGA cohort.

operator_comparisons.implemented: Official CONCH-Z projection/text space; captions append clinical fields and low/typical/high RNA8 states; equal-budget round-robin concept retrieval followed by prediction.
operator_comparisons.new_B5_difference: Fixed phrases and soft local read instead of patient-conditioned natural-language captions and discrete RNA states. Retains continuous measured molecular inputs and separately tests clinical residualization.
operator_comparisons.result: NO_CONFIRMED_INCREMENT; official semantic interface passed; raw-WSI histology QA blocked.

operator_comparisons.implemented: Shared score q(P)k(G)/sqrt(d) + sum_r a_r(P)b_r(G)c_r(C); row/column masked softmax. RNA, gain, loss separate weighted-scalar/coverage tokens.
operator_comparisons.new_B5_difference: Clinical context estimates expected unimodal evidence and is subtracted before low-rank products; it does not directly rewrite every P-G score through a trilinear clinical term. Low-rank products themselves are reused mathematics.
operator_comparisons.result: MECHANISM_NOT_SUPPORTED_IN_THIS_ARCHITECTURE, not rejection of all clinical conditioning.

operator_comparisons.implemented: True-coordinate REGIONS pathology arm, fixed Hallmark50 tokens and separate old-union RNA512 direct risk, strong GRID-local CONCH/S32/clinical Cox anchor, honest same-teacher scalar risk.
operator_comparisons.new_B5_difference: New local interaction may use REGIONS512 but exact historical B0 keeps GRID-local mean PCA32. Shared frozen source and new clinical-residual products require new train-local fits.
operator_comparisons.result: R4 CP_SCALAR DSS 0.832667/0.812398 are historical fold-local counts; nested interaction versus CP_SCALAR +0.001490/-0.000559.

operator_comparisons.implemented: Finite non-saturating/low-capacity readout attribution around fixed CP+RNA offset, 63-model core and 45 selected-control retrains described in local recovery/reproduction metadata.
operator_comparisons.new_B5_difference: Not another readout-only repair; introduces pre-DSS semantic correspondence training and explicit crossfit clinical-background subtraction.
operator_comparisons.result: Current local R5 folder contains recovery/reproduction metadata but no standalone final result table; do not infer new mechanism statistics from those files.

operator_comparisons.implemented: Frozen S7 source with four programs, sparse original-gene value bank, RNA-conditioned original-patch reread and reverse original-gene reread; serial double-difference, no repeated state iteration.
operator_comparisons.new_B5_difference: B5 is not original-gene bidirectional rereading; main defined inputs are fixed Hallmark50 tokens and text morphology reads. Do not import S7/ST weights into this new three-modal contract silently.
operator_comparisons.result: Local R6 data-qualification reports predate training. Actual R6 saved-state existence is independently referenced by R7 9-cell/36-state interface audit and R8 locked source. Fresh source state bytes remain a live asset check.

operator_comparisons.implemented: Train-RMS normalization, independent directions, separate program heads, gated one/two-round states, true wrong-query retrains.
operator_comparisons.new_B5_difference: Avoids interpreting numerical activation as benefit; B5 pretrains without DSS and fits a small frozen-feature Cox readout with explicit capacity/pairing controls.
operator_comparisons.result: 99 fits/297 replays; numerical pathway activated but fixed GATE1 not supported; greater repair than damage not shown.

operator_comparisons.implemented: Frozen R6 source evidence, train-local PCA2 per program, low-capacity complete bilinear program states and frozen RNA-conditioned image read variants.
operator_comparisons.new_B5_difference: B5 adds text-space queries and OOF clinical nuisance residualization, not merely a new name for bilinear readout.
operator_comparisons.result: 81 convex fits/replays; nominal deterministic seed duplicates not independent evidence; R8-6 not supported; no new outer training.

required_contract_clarifications.finding: R4 CP_STRONG LOCAL is frozen legacy outcome-blind GRID-local mean then train-local PCA32, not current REGIONS512.
required_contract_clarifications.resolution: Rebuild historical B0 from exact LOCAL source; lock new REGIONS512 interaction input separately and keep B0_UNIFIED diagnostic distinct.

required_contract_clarifications.finding: Historical direct RNA512 uses the old fixed eight-program union (977 external/955 canonical), whereas new Hallmark50 has 4384 external/4191 RNA-mapped members. Same gene-set names do not imply identical member files.
required_contract_clarifications.resolution: Pin both member/source hashes separately; do not replace historical direct-risk selection with current Hallmark50.

required_contract_clarifications.finding: Mutually orthogonal equal-norm query rows generally cannot simultaneously reproduce the nonorthogonal true-text Gram/singular spectrum.
required_contract_clarifications.resolution: Explicitly define orthogonal random rotation in feature coordinates (T_random=T_text @ Q), preserving row norms/Gram/spectrum while breaking visual-language direction; otherwise report which matching requirement is relaxed. This is a preregistration clarification, not a score-driven choice.

required_contract_clarifications.finding: Existing Phase7 prior has 15 candidate edges across 12 concepts and old molecular states; it is not a qualified 8-group by 50-Hallmark prior and its links are allowed associations, not morphology labels.
required_contract_clarifications.resolution: Before G0 pass, audit/freeze the new mapping and evidence type without target outcomes. Unknown links remain unknown; no dense matrix generated from keyword matches.

required_contract_clarifications.topic: Current server clone and live qualification
required_contract_clarifications.finding: This static sub-audit has not read the current server private data, clone state, model bytes, target patient arrays, or current model forward/backward.
required_contract_clarifications.resolution: Parent-owned live data/hash/geometry/model qualification must complete. Historical PASS files do not set present G0 PASS.

required_contract_clarifications.finding: Historical CONCH projection audit checked 1024 patches; TITAN historical official zero-shot agreement is strong. They do not by themselves satisfy this round repeated real-slide/text equivalence after asset migration.
required_contract_clarifications.resolution: Rebind weights/source/template hashes and rerun agreed official interface checks on current real slides; never raw-CONCH-to-TITAN-text cosine.

required_contract_clarifications.finding: Local R5 recovery metadata and early R6 qualification are not complete standalone current result reports. Later R7/R8 records establish reused model/source lineage, not the missing final files themselves.
required_contract_clarifications.resolution: Inspect cloned server old aggregate ledgers/checkpoints read-only if needed; do not rerun old matrices or fill absent history with inferred PASS.

technical_interfaces.CONCH: normalize(raw_CONCH @ official_visual_proj_contrast) with same-model normalized text; both768.
technical_interfaces.TITAN: normalize(native_slide @ official_vision_encoder_proj) with own normalized TITAN text. Equal-weight slide aggregation is separate from patch budgeting.
technical_interfaces.clinical_background: New train-side OOF no-DSS nuisance means are not implemented in historical Phase19 clinical trilinear score or old RNA caption.
technical_interfaces.anchor: Historical exact CP+RNA scalar is train-local CP/RNA Cox teachers plus one-dimensional same-teacher held-out pairwise logistic calibration; B0 replication is distinct from new shared Efron Cox head.

external_sources.supports: Official existing-feature API projects 768-d CONCH v1.5 with 768x768 proj_contrast before same-model text cosine; no raw WSI needed for this interface.
Official slide encoder consumes CONCH features, coords and per-slide level0 patch size; common 20x/40x examples differ. Historical current-cohort R0 measured all 519 hops as 1024.
Metadata and abstract for consensus molecular subtypes; candidate biological context, not per-patient morphology truth.
Primary study cautions that mesenchymal/EMT bulk signatures can reflect stromal fibroblasts. Search result/full extracted text inspected after direct page fetch redirect failed.

limitations: The same TCGA folds were historically developed repeatedly; future nested evaluation is internal development, not a new external confirmation.
Frozen text cosine is a model proxy, not independent ROI/cell-source or morphology ground truth.
Low-rank products, auxiliary paired contrastive loss, and residualization are not claimed as new mathematics.
A5 spatial-program outcomes and current target DSS tasks cannot be ranked by absolute PCC.
This review does not independently replay old private predictions, model weights or source donor-patient overlap.
